claim: T1 item 6's DETERMINISTIC NEGATIVE CONTROL for sim/pll-lock-mc's campaign: the same campaign, the same testbench stimulus, the same sampling point, the same reducer and the same ratified 1.0% bound, drawn against a DELIBERATELY DEGRADED variant of the DUT -- design/top/top.sch with design/loop-filter's C2 (the shunt capacitor at the charge-pump node whose stated design purpose is to attenuate reference-frequency ripple reaching VCTRL) at a quarter of its drawn area, and nothing else changed. `klt yield` grades a negative control by asking whether the campaign's statistics separate the nominal population from a seeded known-bad variant's own samples of the SAME measurement; this unit produces those samples. It is NOT a design claim and NOT row 9's evidence -- sim/pll-lock-mc holds that, and nothing under design/ instantiates this variant. Its whole purpose is to be worse than the design at exactly one thing, measurably and reproducibly.
spec_rows_note: No spec row is claimed. The measured quantity is the one ratified row 9 bounds (period jitter, RMS, as a fraction of the output period, at CLK in lock) and row 9's own bound is carried verbatim in `measure.jitter.max_frac` with `gate_on_bound` left true exactly as sim/pll-lock-mc has it -- so every trial of this campaign is EXPECTED to be recorded as a FAIL, and that per-trial verdict is this unit's finding rather than a defect. A control whose draws passed would be the failure.

monte_carlo.claim: Six draws at exactly the sampling point sim/pll-lock-mc samples (tt/125C/1.80V, MC_MM_SWITCH and MC_PR_SWITCH both on), seeds 1..6. Six is not a round number, it is the arithmetic in sim/pll-lock-mc/analysis/negative-control/reachability.md: `klt yield` reports a control `detected` only when the control's own empirical yield is strictly below the nominal's AND the control's 95% interval upper bound is strictly below the nominal's lower bound. Against the nominal campaign as it now stands -- record 20260925-224917-3a2dd6e, 5 of 5 draws meeting row 9, Clopper-Pearson lower bound 0.478176 -- a control in which no draw meets the bound has interval upper bound 0.521824 at five draws (NOT detected) and 0.459258 at six (detected). That pair is committed as executed `klt yield` probes p4 and p7 under sim/pll-lock-mc/analysis/negative-control/, so the threshold is a measured property of the tool rather than a formula quoted here. Six is therefore the cheapest sufficient control against today's nominal population, and it is only sufficient if EVERY one of the six locks and EVERY one of the six misses the bound: a draw that never locks carries no period-jitter figure and is censored out of the control's denominator, taking it back to five.
monte_carlo.methodology_note: Every field of this manifest that decides WHAT is measured is sim/pll-lock-mc's own, unchanged: the measured node (CLK), the 20 ps dump grid, the 200 ps internal-step cap, `.options reltol=1e-4`, the 50 us window, the DR-005 discharged-loop-filter cold start, the lock criterion, the 20-cycle post-lock population floor, the ratified 1.0% bound and the (corner, temperature, supply, mismatch, process) sampling point. Only three things differ: the DUT (this unit's degraded variant), the trial count (6, see this block's claim) and the `negative_control` block below. That is checked rather than asserted -- sim/pll-lock-mc/analysis/yield_evidence.py refuses to write a `negative_control` block unless ten of those fields agree between the two manifests. The degradation is a MEASURED choice, not a guessed one: sim/lf-c2-jitter-sensitivity measures this exact netlist's period jitter against the unmodified design's at the same seed and sampling point, which is how the factor was picked to clear row 9's bound while keeping lock.
monte_carlo.analysis: cold-start transient, closed loop, one sky130 statistical draw per trial (`tran 20p 50u 0 200p` under `.options reltol=1e-4`, injected by sim/harness/measure.py from this manifest's own measure block, exactly as sim/pll-lock's PVT points are -- see sim/harness/runner.py's patch_netlist_mc for how the MC_MM_SWITCH/MC_PR_SWITCH/seed cards and this control block combine ahead of the netlist's .end)
